scope: Theorem 5.1 (Branch inequality) of the manuscript “Termination for projective log canonical fourfolds with rational boundary” (preprints/Termination-for-projective-log-canonical-fourfolds-with-rational-boundary-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8ac06a1f5c9a11c5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let p: Y → X be a projective birational morphism of normal projective fourfolds over C. Suppose that Y is Q-factorial and terminal and that (Y, Θ) is an effective terminal pair with rational boundary. Let Q = m ⋃ j=1 Qj be a reduced union of distinct positive-coefficient components of Θ, and assume dim p(Q) ≤ 1. Write Qν j for the normalization of Qj. For each irreducible surface V ⊂ Q, let rV be the number of prime divisors of ∐ j Qν j mapping onto V . Then ∑ V ⊂Q (rV − 1) ≤ m ∑ j=1 ρ∗(Qν j ) + # { v : codimY cY (v) = 3, cY (v) ⊂ Q, a(v; Y, Θ) < 2 } . (5.1) Here the valuations are normalized divisorial orders, and the sum on the left has only finitely many nonzero terms.
